summary: Semantic typography that maps 1:1 to the type token ramp.
purpose: All readable copy. Reach for Text instead of raw Typography or CSS font sizes so roles stay on-token.

anatomy.description: The text node styled by its role.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic type role from the token ramp.

props.name: color
props.description: Optional color override; default is text.primary.

whenToUse: Any on-screen copy that needs a type role.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Interactive labels that are also actions

do: Pick the role that matches hierarchy, not a visual guess.
Keep color on semantic text tokens.
dont: Set fontSize in sx; change the variant instead.

tokensUsed.usage: Each variant resolves font, size, weight, line height.

aria: Use real heading levels that match the page outline.
accessibility.contrast: Body text at least 4.5:1; large text at least 3:1.

related.whenToChoose: Tag for chip labels; Text variant tag for inline type role only.
